notes.title: Hello. We deliver Boys Tale news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41551795/269b994d9a1160c5251e6f0f97dfc95d04045349.png[/img]


1. In the April update, the ability to turn off scenario auto-reading mode has been added.
This revision was made based on suggestions from fans.
If there is anything else that interferes with enjoying Boys Tale, please let me know.

2. We are preparing a new character. Who is that silhouette on the banner?

Thank you to everyone who loves Sia's adventures.
